sentence: First, a faint path of electric charge reaches down from the cloud, in jumps. Each jump is tens of meters long. Each takes about a microsecond.
claim: A lightning leader advances in jumps about 50 meters long, each lasting about a millionth of a second.
status: OPEN: a person must open the link and check

derivation: The stepped leader of a lightning flash advances in steps tens of meters long, each about a microsecond, with pauses of tens of microseconds between them.

sentence: At this speed, a microsecond lasts one whole second.
claim: A millionth of a second, slowed a million times, lasts one second.
note: DERIVATION (our calculation, run it); no outside source.

sentence: At last it touches the ground, and a bright flash runs back up the three-kilometer path. That flash travels up to about a third of the speed of light.
claim: The bright return stroke races up the lightning channel at up to roughly a third of the speed of light.
source_title: NOAA / National Weather Service, lightning science (text not read); Rakov and Uman, Lightning: Physics and Effects (2003)

sentence: Even at a million times slower, it takes at least thirty seconds to climb.
claim: Over a 3-kilometer path, a return stroke at a third of light speed takes about 30 millionths of a second, which is 30 seconds at a million times slower (the 3 km path is our assumption).
note: DERIVATION (our calculation, run it); no outside source. Channel length of 3 km is our assumption (clouds are typically a few km up).
derivation: 3 km / (c/3) = 30 microseconds at the top speed; x 1,000,000 = 30 s, so at least thirty seconds for a slower stroke. The 3 km channel length is our assumption, and the narration says it (three-kilometer path).

sentence: The whole fall from the cloud takes tens of thousandths of a second. At this speed, that would take hours.
claim: A lightning leader takes tens of thousandths of a second to reach the ground; at a million times slower that is hours.
source_title: NOAA / National Weather Service, lightning science (page reached from the builder session, text not read); Uman, The Lightning Discharge
note: FROM MEMORY, NOT OPENED (the builder recalled this; no source text was read this session); a person must open the source and check the number and the wording before posting. sentence: Then the path waits, about thirty to fifty microseconds. Here, that's half a minute or more.
claim: Between lightning leader steps there is a pause of about 50 millionths of a second.
